gloss: favorable, going well, in good form

definitions.gloss: favorable, going well, in good form
definitions.explanation: A state where things are progressing smoothly or performing well. Used for business conditions, sports performance, health recovery, and any situation going better than average.

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{好調|こうちょう}だ。
⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|こん}→今〜：03952_kon⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧{好調|こうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}している→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧。
examples.english: The athlete has maintained good form this season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{好調|こうちょう}な⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限|かぎ}らない→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。
examples.english: It is not necessarily best to start investing when the economy is doing well.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {好調|こうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧: to maintain good performance
- {好調|こうちょう}な⟦{滑|すべ}り{出|だ}し→滑り出し：28049_suberidashi⟧: a strong start
- {好調|こうちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: the good run continues
- ⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧{好調|こうちょう}: strong business results
- {絶|ぜっ}{好調|こうちょう}: in peak form, on top of the world

SIMILAR WORDS:
{好調|こうちょう} vs ⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧: Both mean things are going well. {好調|こうちょう} emphasizes performing above expectations or being in excellent form. ⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧ emphasizes smooth progress according to plan without problems.

{絶|ぜっ}{好調|こうちょう} is a common intensified form meaning "in peak form" or "at one's best."
